newsitem.title: USA: Deposit Guaranty splits stock, ups payout.
newsitem.headline: Deposit Guaranty splits stock, ups payout.

text.p: Deposit Guaranty Corp said it set a two-for-one stock split and increased its quarterly cash dividend of $0.20 per share subsequent to the stock split.
The cash dividend is more than a 14 percent increase over the previous quarter's pre-split dividend of $0.35 per share.
Deposit Guaranty said the dividend is payable on January 2, 1997, to stockholders of record as of December 16.
The stock split will be effective at the close of business on December 2, and shareholders of record on that date will be deemed to be holders of the additional shares at that time, the company said.
Deposit Guaranty also said it plans to file an application to list its common stock on the New York Stock Exchange. The company said it expects to start trading on the NYSE in early December.
